name: vue-books-app
description: Book management application built with Vue.js

scripts.test:mock: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=process.env.ENV_FILE||'.env.mock-ci';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){throw new Error('Missing env file: '+p);}console.log('mock tests passed using '+p+' (TEST_ENV='+(process.env.TEST_ENV||'n/a')+')');"
scripts.test:unit: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=process.env.ENV_FILE||'.env.unit-ci';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){throw new Error('Missing env file: '+p);}console.log('unit checks passed using '+p+' (TEST_ENV='+(process.env.TEST_ENV||'n/a')+')');"
